name: searxng-crawl4ai-mcp
description: Self-hosted web search and page fetching. Talks to your own SearXNG and Crawl4AI through a remote MCP server, so no request leaves your infrastructure for a commercial API. Prefer over WebFetch when reading web pages.

endpoint.title: MCP endpoint URL
endpoint.description: Full URL of your deployed endpoint, including the path. Example: https://mcp.example.com/mcp-searxng-crawl4ai

token.title: Access token
token.description: The bearer token the endpoint enforces (MCP_AUTH_TOKEN).
